notes.title: Free Pride Update Live
notes.notes:
Fellow Stickies!

Today, we're celebrating two attributes that are part of our DNA which we incorporated into Sticky Business: free & unconditional love + Games Made in Germany.

🌈To properly celebrate this, we got a little treat for you! 🌈

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43717490/f89824ee7df33dc9b4e80f872180358f8a750802.png[/img]

Celebrate Pride Month with Sticky Business and explore the free Pride Update! Dive into the joy of managing your own cozy small business: designing stickers, fulfilling orders, and connecting with your customers' stories. 

Embrace the rainbow and express your creativity with [b]95 new stickers[/b], [b]12 fresh goodies[/b], and [b]2 glitter papers[/b]. Also some Quality-of-Life improvements have been added to the update. You can now move elements with WASD, duplicate stickers & inventory tab!

🌈Spread the love in your shop like never before!🌈

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42144621/b306edc8a06cc8c902661de91ed84dc16d1d259c.png[/img]

➡️ Check out the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/games-made-in-germany-2024]🌭 Games Germany 🌭 [/url] event page here!
📺 Watch the 🔴 [url=https://youtu.be/OzTLp-PFU68]IGN live showcase[/url] 🔴 here!

Yours,
Spellgarden Games & Assemble Entertainment

notes.title: STICK OR TREAT UPDATE!
notes.notes:
Boo to you, everyone - it's time for Stick or Treat!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43717490/1257867ffa2992e6a3ddb83f09e82f7fc5416339.gif[/img]

In this update, we added a whole bag of Halloween-themed stickers so you can frankenstein your own creations! 
Get your spoopy booster pack in the game and start creating the most cursed stickers.

We also added matching treats to put in your packages, two spooky packing papers, and a new glitter material.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43717490/2a3c1ae4ccf5036580ac8d576dba97f3770d47ce.png[/img]

And last but not least, we improved the save system to automatically create backups of the game files.
We’re excited to see your spoopy creations, so don’t forget to tag us when you share them online!

Keep sticking!

notes.title: A Colorful Update!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

we hope you all had a strong start into September! We’ve been busy improving Sticky Business and here is everything that’s new with Update 2023.1750:

[h2]New colors![/h2]

This was one of the most popular requests! We added a bunch of new colors to choose from for your stickers:

[table equalcells=1 noborder=1]
[tr]
[td][/td][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43717490/45e93e4589c089e71d98a7e2ad2e16abe71022b0.png[/img][/td][td][/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[h2]New elements![/h2]

These four sticker elements were planned in the original release, but were to shy to make an appearance for launch (and this is of course not because when we put together the sticker names for translations, a few of them slipped through).

With this update you can finally use them!

[table equalcells=1 noborder=1]
[tr]
[td][/td][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43717490/7999d19208d01b0488baaa1989a0e1d254545207.png[/img][/td][td][/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

We also added two other highly requested sticker items! A smaller circle for some more intricate designs and a stripe that you could use to assemble your own pride flags!

[table equalcells=1 noborder=1]
[tr]
[td][/td][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43717490/e07dcf348cd06997a52d1552a5f8822997a4f36c.png[/img][/td][td][/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[h2]Balancing[/h2]

We changed how many stickers customers order in the late game, after all the special customer stories are done. So you’ll get more XP after you finished the stories and can finally unlock all those stickers!

[h2]Better sticker grabbing[/h2]

We’ve changed how sticker elements get selected by the cursor. We now use the exact shape of the sticker element to determine what sticker element you want to click. It should be much easier to select the element you actually wanted to click! 

Before and after:
[table noborder=1]
[tr]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43717490/5190441f2b43bb6d80ab0aa9382ede687709bd3e.gif[/img][/td][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43717490/0aaa09f30c98e470c167e2291b3bf6c9cfca7542.gif[/img][/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[h2]Visual changes[/h2]

We noticed that there were some areas that were a bit hard to understand. So we made the following improvements:
[list]
[*] made unlocked items in the shop a different color, so you see at a first glance what you haven’t bought yet
[*] added a counter for how many items you have bought in each category
[*] better explanation in Twitch messages if you can’t order more stickers
[*] increased the font size in a few areas
[/list]

[h2]Other improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] fixed a bug that could cause the GOG version to crash.
[*] the default input method on Steam Deck is now controller
[*] We fixed the wrong coin balance at the end of the day.
[*] We added a workaround during twitch authentication if other installed programs blocked the games internet connection.
[/list]

We hope you have fun with these new additions! Keep sticking! 🙂

notes.title: First Sticky Business Patch has been released! [version 2023.1695]
notes.notes:
Sticky-fellas and Cozy-lovers alike!
We have just released the first patch for Sticky Business thanks to your ongoing support and overwhelming feedback. 

Without further ado, find all details below: 

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list][[*] Fixed broken sheet overview in tutorial after restarting the game during the tutorial
[*] Fixed the last 4 shop upgrades not working
[*] “All Upgrades” achievement will not count sticker items anymore
[*] Fixed that deleting a sticker would make orders appear again
[*] Fixed Twitch chat being able to order unlisted stickers
[*] Moved the customes names text file to application data so players don’t get the “App wants access to documents” message
[*] Fixed green and yellow noms being switched and made it easier to click the noms
[*] Fixed "Radiant Sparkles" and "Shiny Shimmer” being switched in the upgrades and creator menus
[*] Fixed upgrade view with hearts and stars overlapping
[*] Swapped zodiac signs (leo and capricorn) and adjust costs of all zodiac signs to be the same
[*] Fixed numerous typos and translation issues[/list]

[h3]Additions, Improvements, and more[/h3]
[list][*] We added the version number to the main menu to help with reporting bugs
[*] Improved: You can’t switch to a different order if you’ve placed a sticker in the box to avoid confusion
[*] Increased visibility of how many hearts you get from sticker level-ups
[*] Slightly increased the standard order count per day[/list]


[b]Please keep the feedback coming, you know, where to find us!
Thank you for sticking with us![/b]

notes.title: Sticky Business will release Summer 2023 | New demo available later in June!
notes.notes:
Everyone loves a good unboxing video, amirite? 
But it takes quite more from business owners to pack up those boxes so nicely. 

Today, we're delighted to reveal [b]Sticky Business[/b], our small business simulation game all about making stickers and creating memorable experiences for customers! You will create stickers with thousands of various customization options, pack orders, develop their online store, and build relationships with customers. 

Featured in [i][b]Rokaplay’s[/b][/i] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/cozyfamilyfriendlygamescelebration]“Cozy and Family Friendly Games Celebration”[/url], [b]Sticky Business[/b] is an authentic homage to the essence of a cozy game—unwind, reap rewards, and embrace a gentle journey free of penalties. 
Sticky Business joins today's Rokaplay showcase as a finalist among hundreds of game submissions and will exhibit as part of the Steam event alongside Assemble’s 2D adventure Fall of Porcupine. 

[b]As if that wasn’t cozy enough, a limited-time free demo will be available as part of the Wholesome Direct showcase kicking off on June 10th![/b]
store.steampowered.com/app/2303350/Sticky_Business/?utm_source=steamnews&utm_campaign=announcement

[h3]Watch the Sticky Business announcement trailer on YouTube:[/h3]
[previewyoutube=HEgbHhKCSoc;full][/previewyoutube]


[b]Coming to PC via Steam later this summer[/b], [b]Sticky Business[/b] relishes in the wholesome fun and simplicity of childlike creativity: creating stickers! With thousands of design options at your fingertips, the task may seem daunting at first, but the game’s approachable interface and charming visuals create a totally serene experience for the would-be small business owner. 

Of course, it can’t be all sticky, there’s also the tricky aspect of business management:
You must create an engaging, welcoming online storefront, allowing even more bursts of creativity and personal expression. From there, you can manage sales, pack orders, and even decide what sorts of goodies customers receive in their boxes. But even the tricky parts of business ownership prove rewarding, as what comes next is sitting back and watch the positive impact your stickers have on your customers’ lives.


[h3]What's in the box?[/h3]
[list][*] Mix and match a plethora of the most wholesome and day-brightening stickers to create collections that are true to you — thousands of possible combinations available!
[*] Grow your business gradually, and expand your boxed orders to include sweet gifts
[*] A beautiful pastel palette will soothe your eyes just as the relaxing background tracks will soothe your ears
[*] Buy upgrades with your hard-earned revenue to get more sticker graphics and effect foils to make your shop even more tempting for customers[/list]

As a special bonus for content creators, we're pleased to announce a [b]dedicated Twitch integration[/b] that will launch with [b]Sticky Business[/b]. The integration will allow viewers in chat to put in “orders” for the streamer to pack in-game!
